name: Seed Junky | 3.5g Prepackaged Flower | Cherry Cap
description:
Cherry Cap layers sweet cherry brightness with creamy dessert notes and a bold, gassy backbone. 
the inhale leans fruity and smooth, while the exhale leaves a pungent, fuel- forward finish that reflects its powerhouse lineage. Effects strike with uplifting mental clarity and steady body calm, making it versatile for daytime creativity or evening relaxation. 

Cherry Pie x Cap Junky
